records.judge_reason: Help output and shell completion match the labelled themes almost exactly. The report merges several labelled themes: parser plus parts of Click 9.0, commands/context and errors all go into one large 'Parser behavior, parser rewrite and Click 9.0' bucket. That bucket mixes unrelated issues such as error display (#2853, #2740, #531), dynamic choice (#928) and the 9.0 release issues. 'Prompts, terminal utilities and file/path types' combines two labelled themes, but the result is still somewhat coherent. The last theme ('Typing, public API, async, testing and documentation') is a catch-all grab-bag. It mixes internals, async/embedding, docs, set types, #2801 (command invocation) and #2676 (negative-number parsing), which belongs with the parser. The colored-output theme is coherent but pulls the color-related exception issues out of the errors theme. Some themes match; others are vague or mix unrelated issues.

records.judge_reason: Several report themes line up well with the labelled ones. 'Help output and formatter customisation' and 'Shell completion' closely match, though #1574 (list_commands context) is misplaced in completion. Merging colour and exceptions with terminal utilities, and Click 9.0 with the parser rewrite, is broader but still coherent. However, the report leaves out large parts of the issue set. The entire 'Parameter types and files' theme is missing (#3888, #3036, #2645, #2429, #1428, #1378, #928). Almost all of 'Commands, context and embedding' is missing (#2783, #2753, #2402, #2361, #2360, #2033, #1322, #1269, #680, #473). Many parsing/options issues are also absent (#2824, #2786, #2771, #2768, #1279, #742, #730), as are #531, #2493 and #1997. 'Docs and tutorial' mixes in unrelated issues: #2801 (a missing-arguments bug) and #2676 (negative number parsing). #2992 is misplaced into the 9.0 theme. The existing themes are mostly reasonable, but the coverage gaps and some mixed groupings mean the report reproduces only part of the labelled structure.

records.judge_reason:
Several report themes line up with the labelled ones. Shell completion matches exactly. Async support is a coherent subset of the labelled commands theme. Prompts and stdin/piped input is a coherent subset of the terminal I/O theme. Help output and formatting matches the help customisation theme, with #944 (exception colour) added.

The weaker groupings:
- "Parser and processing pipeline design" is overloaded. It folds most of the labelled commands/context issues (#1269, #1322, #473, #680, #1574) together with the parsing issues, and also absorbs #531 (an error-handling issue). That merges two labelled themes into one broad bucket.
- "Parameter types, options and utilities" is a catch-all. It mixes coherent param-type issues with #2154 (xdg-open zombie after launch) and #1997 (test runner output depending on terminal width), which are unrelated. It also includes #90901 (sharing options), which belongs with parsing/options.
- The errors theme disappeared, and its two issues were scattered into other themes.

Overall, a few themes are good matches, but there is one large merged theme and one grab-bag mixing unrelated issues.

top_issues.reason: Well-reproduced bug: completing long options written as --opt=value is broken in bash and zsh.
The AliasedGroup example in the docs crashes with an AttributeError during completion when the command name has a typo. The fix to the docs is simple.
A UsageError raised during shell completion prints a full traceback to the user instead of a clean message.
Correctness bug: multi-value options override the value the callback returns.
Meta issue with a lot of discussion that guides future parser changes and several related parsing issues.

records.judge_reason: Several report themes line up with the labelled ones. Help output matches closely, LazyFile/file handling matches exactly, and the core parser issues are grouped correctly. The exceptions theme sensibly pairs the ClickException issues with the color and stream issues, but it also pulls in the unrelated i18n issue #2706. Other parts are mixed. 'Shell completion bugs and tracebacks' combines the two completion issues with an exception/traceback issue (#2853) and a resolve_command bug (#2402), which are unrelated topics. The parser theme absorbs the commands/context issues #2753, #2801 and #2783, so the commands and context theme disappears and the parser theme becomes a catch-all. The 9.0/internals group is split up: typing (#2493) is left as a one-issue theme, i18n is misplaced, and #2823 is missing entirely. Overall some themes match, but others mix unrelated issues.

themes.name: Parser behaviour and future parser design

top_issues.reason: Bug with clear repro steps: completing --opt=value is broken in bash and zsh, and in zsh the option itself gets removed.
Wrong-result bug: multi-value options override the value that the callback returns.
Meta issue for future parser changes; it is the most discussed issue (15 comments) and many parsing issues depend on it.
Default callbacks run during tab completion, which can cause side effects or slow completion.
LazyFile opens and closes the file early, which breaks reading from a FIFO.

records.judge_reason: Most report themes line up with the labelled ones: shell completion, help output, parsing, exceptions, context/embedding and file handling all match well. There are a few problems. #2853, an exception/call stack issue, is placed under shell completion and also duplicated in exceptions. #2419 appears in both help output and exceptions. #2402 appears in both exceptions and context. #2801 moved from commands into parsing, which is arguable. #2706 (i18n) sits in the context theme, which fits poorly. #2823 is missing entirely, and there is no theme for 9.0 and internals. Overall the groupings are mostly right, with some misplaced and duplicated issues.
